meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided on it, and when?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.

So you decided, on a number from a piece of software. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your school's procedure 4.3 says the same thing. What else do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for entering it without first speaking to me, as procedure 4.2 requires. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and she is heading to the principal, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her nothing she could read and check herself.
What cost ground: You gave the detector score as your whole reason for the zero, which handed her the software maker's own warning and the school's procedure 4.3 in one move.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you showed no dates or times at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and when, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home, then put something dated from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
